conv_096.speaker: xX_EmberQuill_Xx
conv_096.text: I raise this matter before the council, {player}. We need {troop_count} spears to hold {village} before winter.

conv_096.text: Eat before you march, friend. xX_EmberQuill_Xx talks in circles when there is gold on the table.

conv_096.speaker: xX_EmberQuill_Xx
conv_096.text: The Fen will pay {gold} gold for the spears, delivered to {town} by the new moon. The terms are generous, I assure you.

conv_096.speaker: hollowcairn
conv_096.text: Generous terms are still terms. Who holds the road to {town} when the spears arrive?

conv_096.speaker: xX_EmberQuill_Xx
conv_096.text: The road is my concern and I have already secured it, hollowcairn. Your eldermen will be consulted before any vote.

conv_096.speaker: hollowcairn
conv_096.text: Then I will come to the council and listen. Bring me the ledger, not the speech.
